title: Evolution of Coronary Computed Tomography Radiation Dose Reduction at a Tertiary Referral Center
version: American Journal of Medicine 125(8), pp. 764–772. DOI 10.1016/j.amjmed.2011.10.036.
lineage: Massachusetts General Hospital retrospective study. Independent observations of the two scanner configurations and use at that hospital.

passages.note: Distinguishes first-generation SOMATOM Definition and second-generation Definition Flash, including paired detector configurations and rotation times. The site began scanning on Flash in April 2010.
